TextBlock.Text: MGS: HNS, come and look at this! A small dwelling, built entirely from sweet-bread and sugar. I have never seen architecture like it.
HNS: Strange. Who would build a house out of food? And look at the floor - four striped pillars, arranged around a sealed hatch.
MGS: The hatch will not open, no matter how hard I pull. But each pillar has a shallow cradle on top. I believe something is meant to rest on each one.
HNS: Four cradles, so four objects. The carvings around them show four shapes: a heart, a star, a wrapped sweet and a square of chocolate.
MGS: My signalscope is picking up faint melodies on a frequency I have never heard before. Perhaps the objects are singing to us! I will search the hills, you follow the chocolate river.
HNS: Agreed. Whatever lies beneath that hatch, we will find it together. And MGS - please stop eating the walls.
